capabilities: Create highlights, comments, suggestions, questions and replies stored in .agent-review/ without modifying Markdown
Manage and filter reviews in a unified ReviewView with bulk actions
Pin reviews as spatial sticky notes and draw editable Bézier relation lines between them
Re-anchor reviews after text changes and resolve orphans
Export reviews to Markdown or JSON and expose file, CLI and API interfaces for external AI agents
disambiguation: Not an AI plugin itself; it ships no built-in LLM and only provides a structured data layer that external agents access through files, a CLI, or an API.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README is bilingual (Chinese and English) and documents known limits: complex spatial editing is desktop-only and multi-device conflict-merge UI is not yet implemented.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in annotation system that keeps highlights, comments, replies and relations as structured records outside the Markdown text or lets external AI agents operate on the same review data.
summary: Structured reading annotation plugin that stores highlights, comments, sticky notes and Bézier relation lines as data separate from Markdown, for human and AI agent review.
